parameters.query:
SELECT clinic_id, business_name, timezone, rate_per_show_cents, bills_returning
FROM clinics
WHERE status = 'active'
ORDER BY clinic_id;

-- Idempotent on appointment_id. The sync re-runs the same window nightly,
-- so every write must be safe to repeat.
--
-- Rates are NOT touched here. A rate is frozen onto the event when it becomes
-- billable, and re-deriving it later would silently rewrite an invoice.
INSERT INTO billable_events
  (appointment_id, clinic_id, contact_id, booked_at, starts_at,
   outcome, outcome_at, outcome_source, is_new_patient, booked_by, synced_at)
SELECT r->>'appointment_id',
       r->>'clinic_id',
       nullif(r->>'contact_id',''),
       (r->>'booked_at')::timestamptz,
       (r->>'starts_at')::timestamptz,
       r->>'outcome',
       nullif(r->>'outcome_at','')::timestamptz,
       r->>'outcome_source',
       (r->>'is_new_patient')::boolean,
       r->>'booked_by',
       now()
FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) AS r
ON CONFLICT (appointment_id) DO UPDATE
   SET outcome       = EXCLUDED.outcome,
       outcome_at    = EXCLUDED.outcome_at,
       outcome_source= EXCLUDED.outcome_source,
       synced_at     = now()
   -- never walk an invoiced line backwards
   WHERE billable_events.state NOT IN ('invoiced','written_off');

-- Promote attended events to billable, freezing the rate at this moment.
UPDATE billable_events b
   SET state = 'billable',
       rate_cents = c.rate_per_show_cents
  FROM clinics c
 WHERE b.clinic_id = c.clinic_id
   AND b.state = 'pending'
   AND b.outcome = 'attended'
   AND (c.bills_returning OR b.is_new_patient)
RETURNING b.appointment_id;
